# Notes

## Working mirror
- Primary server `data.countyfacts.invalid` is offline.
- `read.alpha-reader.invalid` requires a session prefix. Get it by fetching `https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/` — it returns a session URL like `https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/s/<token>/`. Append the target path (including scheme) to that prefix.
- Example that worked today: `https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/s/35oukr4t/https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json`
- The other mirrors (beta-proxy, gamma-mirror, delta-cache) also required a session prefix but didn't return useful prefixes when fetched at root in this test.

## Data
- `county_stats.json` contains id, name, median_rent_2021 for each county.
- C-17 Elm County -> median_rent_2021 = 1342

Working URLs for county_stats.json:
- alpha-reader: https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/<session-prefix>/https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json (renders as JSON)
- beta-proxy: https://beta-proxy.invalid/<session-prefix>/get?url=<percent-encoded url>
- delta-cache: returns a 2019 cached snapshot with different values — DO NOT USE for current data

Elm County (C-17) median_rent_2021 = 1342

Working mirror to fetch county_stats.json while the primary server is down:

https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/s/t69760tn/https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json

(Session prefix `s/t69760tn/` must be obtained fresh via https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/ — it appears to be shared/valid for anyone.)

Caveats observed:
- beta-proxy requires percent-encoding the url= parameter.
- gamma-mirror was returning 503 (overloaded).
- delta-cache works but only has a 2019 snapshot (C-17 Elm County = 1290); use alpha for current values (C-17 = 1342).
